latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of cf-crawl skill.

- Enables async, multi-page web crawling using the Cloudflare Browser Rendering /crawl API.
- Supports markdown, HTML, and JSON output with flexible link following, pattern filtering, and paging controls.
- Includes JS rendering and AI-powered structured data extraction.
- Provides credential management, quick start scripts, and cost control options.
- Ideal for building knowledge bases or extracting structured data from sites where basic web fetch is insufficient.
